ROW.COLUMN: (ML/AC) Patterns of Sequentially Numbered Checks, Monetary Instruments

Money launderers seeking to place funds into the banking system may purchase, or employ agents to purchase, large numbers of monetary instruments at various locations, such as bank branches or postal offices. One typology is to purchase a string of money orders that aggregate to just under the cash log threshold of USD 3,000 (or specific jurisdiction equivalent), or the currency-reporting threshold of USD 10,000 (or specific jurisdiction equivalent). These instruments are deposited into another, typically non-US institution, and then cleared through that institution's correspondent account with a US bank. Or, the funds may be deposited in this manner into domestic accounts (retail and commercial), then transferred to other accounts and eventually out of the institution. This scenario identifies accounts or correspondent banks that have substantial risk as a result of the placement of large numbers of sequentially numbered monetary instruments (such as money orders) into the banking system.

SELECT a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID, b.ACCT_INTRL_ID, a.HH_ACCT_GRP_ID, c.NVSMT_MGR_SEQ_ID FROM @MINER@.NVSMT_MGR c inner join @MINER@.MANGD_ACCT b inner join @MINER@.ACCT a on (b.ACCT_INTRL_ID=a.ACCT_INTRL_ID) on (c.NVSMT_MGR_INTRL_ID=b.NVSMT_MGR_INTRL_ID)

-- Enh 38736742 select @MINER@.F_CheckMISeqAC2 (@Lrf_Digits, @Min_Individual_Trans_Am, @MaxSkp1dgt, @Min_Epi_Ct, @Min_Trans_Ct, @Min_Trans_Am, @Max_Trans_Am, @Frequency_Period, @Look_Back_Period, @MINER@.Lst(@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst), @All_Jurisdictions_Fl, @MINER@.Lst(@Mantas_Bus_Acct_Type_Lst), @MINER@.Lst(@Incl_Trans_Src_Lst), @All_Trans_Src_Fl, @Include_Trusted_Trans_FL, @MINER@.Lst(@Incl_MI_Trxn_Prdct_Type_Lst), @Curr_Type, @Include_B2B_Trnfr_Fl, @ChkNb_Dgt_Ct, '!#Standard#!' --date format 'YYYYMMDD' ) as ACCT_SEQ_ID, 'dummy' as ACCT_INTRL_ID from dual
UNION ALL
SELECT a.ACCT_SEQ_ID, a.ACCT_INTRL_ID FROM (select ACCT_SEQ_ID, ACCT_INTRL_ID from ( with clndr_vw as ( select (select add_days(cal.CLNDR_DT, -@Look_Back_Period) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL cal where cal.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and cal.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) as Min_Dt, (select cal.clndr_dt from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL cal where cal.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and cal.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) as Max_Dt, (select add_days(cal.CLNDR_DT, -@Frequency_Period) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL cal where cal.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and cal.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) as Freq_Dt FROM dual )
SELECT mi1.ACCT_INTRL_ID , mi1.ACCT_SEQ_ID FROM ( --filtered transactions for the lookback period SELECT a.ACCT_INTRL_ID , a.ACCT_SEQ_ID , mi3.BENEF_ACCT_ID , mi3.DATA_DUMP_DT , DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',mi3.TRXN_FUNC_AM,mi3.TRXN_BASE_AM) as TRXN_AM FROM @MINER@.ACCT a, @MINER@.MI_TRXN mi3
WHERE mi3.BENEF_ACCT_ID = a.ACCT_INTRL_ID --Account filters --Include Customer Retail Accounts Only AND a.MANTAS_ACCT_HOLDR_TYPE_CD='CR' -- Include Account Business Types Specified in Mantas Business Acct Types Parameter AND a.MANTAS_ACCT_BUS_TYPE_CD in (@Mantas_Bus_Acct_Type_Lst) -- Include all account when All Jurisdictions is set to 'Y' or -- Accounts with jurisdiction only specified in Included Jurisdiction Codes Parameter AND (a.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst) or @All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y') -- Exclude Exempt Accounts AND a.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 --20039352 AND mi3.MANTAS_POST_DT > (select Min_Dt from clndr_vw) AND mi3.MANTAS_POST_DT <= (select Max_Dt from clndr_vw) AND mi3.DATA_DUMP_DT > (select Min_Dt from clndr_vw) AND mi3.DATA_DUMP_DT <= (select Max_Dt from clndr_vw) AND mi3.AUG_INSTR_NB is not null AND mi3.BENEF_ACCT_ID is not null AND (mi3.INSTR_NM is not null or mi3.INSTR_ROUTG_CD is not null) AND mi3.INTRL_BENEF_ACCT_FL = 'Y' AND (mi3.SRC_SYS_CD in (@Incl_Trans_Src_Lst) or @All_Trans_Src_Fl='Y') --Minimum individual transaction amount for transactions in episodes AND DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',mi3.TRXN_FUNC_AM,mi3.TRXN_BASE_AM) >= @Min_Individual_Trans_Am --Cash-equialent mi-transactions only AND mi3.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD in (@Incl_MI_Trxn_Prdct_Type_Lst) -- PR32282 -- Cover only GENERAL transactions AND mi3.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' -- PR # 41641: on 11/18/2009 ADDED TRUSTED PAIR FUNCTIONALITY AND (@Include_Trusted_Trans_FL = 'Y' or COALESCE(mi3.TRSTD_TRXN_FL,'N') ='N') AND (@Include_B2B_Trnfr_Fl= 'Y' or NOT(mi3.BANK_TO_BANK_TRNFR_FL = 'Y' and mi3.PASS_THRU_FL = 'N')) -- Divide By Zero error handling AND DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',mi3.TRXN_FUNC_AM,mi3.TRXN_BASE_AM) IS NOT NULL AND DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',mi3.TRXN_FUNC_AM,mi3.TRXN_BASE_AM) <> 0 --30071744 exclude the cheque numbers that contain all 0'S like "00000" AND regexp_instr(regexp_replace(mi3.AUG_INSTR_NB,' ',''),'[0]{'||length(regexp_replace(mi3.AUG_INSTR_NB,' ',''))||',}') = 0
) mi1
GROUP BY mi1.ACCT_SEQ_ID, mi1.ACCT_INTRL_ID HAVING max(mi1.DATA_DUMP_DT) > (select Freq_Dt from clndr_vw) AND max(mi1.DATA_DUMP_DT) <= (select Max_Dt from clndr_vw) --Bug 38624207 AND sum(mi1.TRXN_AM) > = @Min_Trans_Am * @Min_Epi_Ct AND count(*) >= @Min_Trans_Ct * @Min_Epi_Ct ) ) a

SELECT a.ACCT_INTRL_ID, a.ACCT_SEQ_ID, a.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB, ta.Episode_Ct, ta.Tot_Trans_Base_Amt, ta.Tot_Trans_Func_Amt, ta.Func_Crncy_Cd, ta.Actvy_Risk_Nb, ta.Tot_Pass_Thru_Am, ta.Tot_Lrf_Am, ta.Tot_Hr_Am, ta.Tot_Trxn_Ct, ta.Trusted_Trans_Am, (select cal.clndr_dt from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL cal where cal.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and cal.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) as Curr_Dt FROM @MINER@.ACCT a, ( select t.Acct_Intrl_Id, count(distinct(t.episode_nb)) as Episode_Ct, sum(t.trxn_base_am) as Tot_Trans_Base_Amt, sum(t.trxn_func_am) as Tot_Trans_Func_Amt, max(t.func_crncy_cd) as Func_Crncy_Cd, max(t.benef_actvy_risk_nb) as Actvy_Risk_Nb, sum(t.pass_thru_am) as Tot_Pass_Thru_Am, sum(t.lrf_am) as Tot_Lrf_Am, sum(t.hr_am) as Tot_Hr_Am, count(*) as Tot_Trxn_Ct, sum(case when t.TRSTD_TRXN_FL = 'Y' then t.trxn_am else 0 end) as Trusted_Trans_Am from @MINER@.CHECK_MI_SEQ_AC_TEMP2 t group by acct_intrl_id having count(distinct(episode_nb)) >= @Min_Epi_Ct -- verificatin of the frequency period and max(t.data_dump_dt) >= max(t.start_frequency) ) ta where ta.Acct_Intrl_Id = a.ACCT_INTRL_ID

Parameter that allows coverage of all jurisdictions without enumerating them in the Included Jurisdiction Codes threshold: Y: Cover all jurisdiction codes regardless of the Included Jurisdiction Codes threshold value. Parameter which controls the inclusion or exclu-sion of bank-to-bank transactions: Y: Includes transactions with a bank-to-bank transfer. N: Excludes transactions with a bank-to-bank transfer and the originator or beneficiary is the ultimate originator or beneficiary of the funds (i.e., Pass Through `Indicator is set to No).

Parameter that controls the inclusion or exclusion of transactions which have been designated as trusted transactions. Trusted transactions are those transactions considered trusted based upon the presence of one or more trusted pairs (parties identified as enjoying a trusted relationship) on the transaction. Y: Include trusted transactions N: Exclude trusted transactions
